properties.displayName: Enforce Microsoft Default Rule Set for WAF
properties.description: Requires Application Gateway and Premium Azure Front Door WAF policies to include Microsoft_DefaultRuleSet. The initial Audit effects allow compliance testing before enforcement.

nonComplianceMessages.message: Application Gateway and Premium Azure Front Door WAF policies must include Microsoft_DefaultRuleSet in managed rules.
Application Gateway WAF policies must use the Microsoft_DefaultRuleSet as the default rule set.
Premium Azure Front Door WAF policies must use the Microsoft_DefaultRuleSet as the default rule set.
